I think their wrappers like claude design and cowork are decent. But Claude code as a harness is bloated and unnecessary, Boris admitted that himself. 

Most of their features are workflows you can build yourself and it would probably be better if you did. I remember when people hyped about plan mode last year. I stopped using that and use my own plan prompt last december and it’s been way better.

GPT is a much more capable and proficient model especially combined with opencode I don’t think you can beat it for reasoning and coding.
